description: This is a test module for the Lambda AI provider integration within the litellm project. It contains unit tests using pytest and unittest.mock to verify configuration, environment variable handling, provider registration, model information, and API interactions for Lambda AI models.

methods.name: test_lambda_ai_config_initialization()
methods.description: Tests that LambdaAIChatConfig initializes correctly with default values.

methods.name: test_lambda_ai_get_openai_compatible_provider_info()
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of API base URL and API key from default, environment variables, and explicit parameters.

methods.name: test_get_llm_provider_lambda_ai()
methods.description: Checks that get_llm_provider correctly identifies Lambda AI models and API base overrides.

methods.name: test_lambda_ai_in_provider_lists()
methods.description: Ensures Lambda AI provider is registered in the recognized provider lists.

methods.name: test_lambda_ai_completion_call()
methods.description: Tests asynchronous completion call with Lambda AI provider, skipping if API key is not set.

methods.name: test_lambda_ai_models_configuration()
methods.description: Verifies Lambda AI models are correctly configured with provider info, mode, and features.

methods.name: test_lambda_ai_model_list_populated()
methods.description: Checks that the list of Lambda AI models is populated correctly and contains expected models.
